items.text: The ? button opens help beside the page and points to the part it explains.
If a teammate shares a group of stores with you, pick it under Shared in the store search.
Hovering over a button or label shows a clear tip beside your mouse.
Date pickers show the day of the week.
The button that takes you back to your results now says Back.
Pop-up windows soften the page behind them instead of darkening it.
Each store opens on Summary, a one-page recap of its week or any single day.
Compare a store with any other store in your group from the Compare tab.
Investigate a department that's behind another store to see which items are causing it.
Top 200 ranks a store's best sellers by sales dollars, and can compare two stores.
Sub depts can compare two stores, department by department.
Download Summary's item list for one day or up to 31 days.
Last week's figures line up correctly after the clocks change.
The page keeps the week, store and group you searched when you come back to it.
Each row shows this week, last week and last year side by side, with a Sales / Units switch.
Bars are green when you're ahead and red when you're behind, and each card shows the dollar difference.
Sub Dept Margins, Vendors and Categories open on the store you were already looking at.
Items that sold the same as last week are no longer flagged red.
Both pages show the same margin for the same store and week.

items.page: Sub Dept Margins, Categories and Vendors
items.text: Store totals leave out fuel, lottery and cash, matching the figures beside them.
A coupon sale's lines still show after you leave the page and come back.
A looked-up item opens as a report with a 14-day chart and a row for each day.
The phone camera waits for a clean read before it takes a barcode.
Pressing Enter searches, and an item with no sales says so.
On a phone, Cashiers looks like the other pages: pick the exception from the card's title, and amounts show in full.
A new Movement tab shows how much of an item each store moved, week by week.
Week over week and Trend compare fairly: whole weeks only, against the 90 days before your dates.
An item that stopped selling is labelled Stopped selling.
Download waits until your data has loaded.
A group search covers only the stores assigned to you.
Received quantities are counted in cases.
On a phone, Coupons uses the same sort buttons and totals card as the other pages.
Column filters stay in place when you leave the page and come back.
Share a group of stores with your team from the new Shared Groups tab.
Choose whether each person follows their groups automatically or sees only the stores you pick.
Editing a user uses the same steps as adding one.
Deactivate or reactivate several users at once.
A new Access column shows how each person gets their stores, with a filter for it.
Assign all shows who it will move, and only moves the people your search shows.
A base group's download can include its users as well as its stores.
A new base group offers to add itself to you, so you can fill it straight away.
Add user no longer fills in your own login.
The user list sorts by any column, and the page asks before you lose unsaved changes.
Choose which sub departments, like lottery and money orders, don't count toward a store's net sales.
